summary: Transport and execute immutable Capability DecisionEnvelope V2 through Samantha Companion, Continuum, Remote Bridge and external MCP.
reason: Capability-First admission previously resolved intent before model but execution could later resolve the same text again; V2 carries one validated semantic decision to the effect boundary.
rollback: Revert the runtime V2 commit together with the UI V2 commit. Existing submission reconciliation, Capability-First, Continuum and Payment Core stores need no migration.

capabilities.reason: Execution semantics now consume the canonical frozen decision through Companion/MCP/Continuum; payment owner selection cannot be reclassified before its human boundary.

architecture.reason: Cross-surface semantic/execution boundary is versioned as DecisionEnvelope V2; existing owners are extended without a new component.

limitations: No financial effect is executed during architecture acceptance.
The rollout compatibility branch accepts pre-V2 resolutions until the installed UI floor is verified.
